experiences.summary: Backend architecture across client platforms — Laravel Horizon queues, MySQL tuning and a central notification module for the Focus learning platform, after SB7, Ecom Intelligence and the Grameenphone MyGP back-end squad.
details: Focus Learning Platform (May 2026 – Nov 2026, maintenance & support from Sep 2026) — led backend architecture and infrastructure for a high-traffic exam platform.
Scaled exam traffic with isolated Laravel Horizon queues and autoscaling workers.
Optimized MySQL indexes on a large results table and moved bulk PDF/Excel exports to resumable queues.
Built a central notification module and introduced AI-DLC for planning and audits.
SB7 Affiliate Marketing Platform (Mar 2026 – May 2026) — built features, cleared legacy technical debt, integrated third-party platforms, reviewed code and paired with developers.
Ecom Intelligence (Feb 2026 – Mar 2026) — contributed to a multi-tenant SaaS e-commerce proof of concept for tenant subdomain routing and request handling.
Grameenphone MyGP Back-End Squad (Jan 2025 – Feb 2026) — solution design, feature delivery, backend development and code reviews for a telco-scale consumer app.
Built internal PHP packages for Redis optimization, failover, async multi-cURL requests and feature-toggled logging.
Contributed to Laravel upgrades across microservices, managing dependency compatibility.
Worked on authentication, offers, pack purchase, live score, API Gateway, SSO and the admin panel; took part in L10 meetings, quarterly Rocks and team management.

experiences.summary: Grameenphone MyGP sprint delivery and optimization — a BFF/API Gateway proof of concept, Redis-cached global configuration, and the authentication move from MySQL to Cassandra.
details: Contributed to a Backend-for-Frontend and API Gateway proof of concept that combined backend calls into async responses and reduced latency.
Reworked the global configuration API with Redis caching and a microservice fallback, cutting redundant service calls.
Contributed to the authentication migration from MySQL to Cassandra using worker-based data migration.
Helped refactor the login microservice out of the monolith, using feature toggles and the adapter pattern to switch between Cassandra and MySQL.

experiences.summary: Grameenphone MyGP microservice refactoring — breaking a large monolithic back end into microservices, plus a Change Data Capture proof of concept for near real-time sync.
details: Contributed to refactoring a large monolithic back end into microservices using design patterns and separation of concerns.
Conducted a Change Data Capture proof of concept for near real-time data sync.

experiences.summary: Worked on a warehouse and logistics management system with configurable workflows and dynamic billing for multiple logistics companies.
details: Configurable workflows and dynamic billing for multiple logistics companies.
Involved in developing a Firebase-based cloud messaging system.

experiences.summary: Led development of a Human Resource Information System with role-based access control and workflows.
details: Modules covering performance management, training, e-recruitment, scientific ranking and certificates.
Role-based access control and workflow management across modules.

experiences.summary: Developed news and job portals, an online exam and result application, and a domain registration system with payment gateway and DNS integration.
details: News and job portals.
Online exam and result application.
Domain registration system with payment gateway and DNS integration.
Improved page speed with browser caching, GZIP and asset minification.
